prisoners_dilemma.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
prisoners_dilemma.description: You are participating in a Prisoner's Dilemma. If both cooperate, both get 3 points. If one defects while the other cooperates, the defector gets 5 points and the cooperator gets 0. If both defect, both get 1 point. Your goal is to maximize your own score.

stag_hunt.name: Stag Hunt
stag_hunt.description: You are hunting. You can choose to hunt a Stag or a Hare. Hunting a Stag requires cooperation and yields the highest reward (4) for both. Hunting a Hare can be done alone and guarantees a small reward (1), while the other player gets nothing (0) if they hunted the Stag.
